title: Design System: Agrupamento 80 — Santa Maria de Belém

display.purpose: Hero/carousel titles over photography, with text shadow for legibility.

headline.purpose: Page titles, set in Verde Escutista, centered.

title.purpose: Card titles, section headings, modal headers.

body.purpose: Running text at 1.6 line-height; 600 weight for emphasis.

label.purpose: Uppercase badges and chips only — the one place tracking goes positive.

lead.purpose: The one-sentence standfirst under the hero: 600, 1.25rem (1.125rem on phones), 1.45, Cinza Escuro, balanced, centred.

diagram-fret.purpose: The starting-fret marker inside a chord diagram (700, --font-size-xs, Cinza Médio); the smallest step on the ramp.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Sticky header and subtle resting separation (--shadow-sm).

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Hovered cards, dropdown menus, modal panels (--shadow-lg).

shadows.name: fab
shadows.purpose: The one always-elevated element; it floats over content by definition.

shadows.name: photo-scrim
shadows.purpose: Hero carousel scrim; darkens only where the copy sits (phones: 0.75 / 0.55 at 45% / 0.25 at 75% / 0.1).

shadows.name: photo-headline-text
shadows.purpose: text-shadow on the hero headline over photography.

shadows.name: photo-supporting-text
shadows.purpose: text-shadow on the hero supporting line.

shadows.name: photo-dot
shadows.purpose: Keeps the white carousel page dots visible over pale photos.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Card lifts and larger state changes.

motion.name: transition-interactive
motion.value: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease
motion.purpose: The only sanctioned multi-property interactive transition — compositor/paint-safe properties, never layout, never `all`.

motion.name: panel-in
motion.purpose: Modal panel materialize: fade + translateY(12px) scale(0.98); bottom sheets rise 48px on mobile.

motion.name: carousel-settle
motion.purpose: Slide settle for autoplay and dots; shorter when a swipe hands over its velocity.

motion.name: photo-develop
motion.value: opacity 450ms ease-out, filter 1200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 1200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: Home story photos develop like prints (grayscale 1.04 scale → colour at rest) the first time they are loaded and on screen; 90ms apart in reading order; instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: ladder-draw
motion.purpose: Age ruler bars draw in each time the ruler rises into view from above.

motion.name: ladder-retract
motion.value: transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.84, 0), 70ms stagger, last bar first
motion.purpose: Age ruler bars retract when scrolling back up drops the ruler below the trigger line.

motion.name: fab-morph
motion.purpose: The FAB's envelope turns into the up arrow past 300px of scroll (quarter-turn and scale crossover; crossfade under reduced motion).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Verde Mata pill CTA; darkens on hover, scales to 0.97 on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); color: #fff; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; border: none; border-radius: 100px; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-green-deep, #0b6630); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-green, #129648); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toolbar toggle; tints green on hover, fills Verde Nevoeiro when active.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-gray-700, #404040); background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200, #e5e5e5); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); color: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-chip-active { border-color: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); background: var(--color-green-light, #e8f5ee); color: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Flat at rest with a hairline border; lifts −4px with shadow on hover while the cover zooms.

components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 320px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200, #e5e5e5); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 250ms ease, transform 250ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-media { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #129648, #0e7a3a); } .ds-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 0.75rem; left: 0.75rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.7rem; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; background: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); border-radius: 100px; } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--color-black, #1a1a1a); } .ds-card-excerpt { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-gray-500, #6e6e6e); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Icon-led field; the border quietly turns Verde Escutista on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; max-width: 320px; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 1rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: var(--color-gray-500, #6e6e6e); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.75rem 2.5rem; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-gray-200, #e5e5e5); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--color-black, #1a1a1a); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-search-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Quiet gray link that turns green over a Verde Nevoeiro tint on hover/active.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-gray-700, #404040); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:active, .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); background-color: var(--color-green-light, #e8f5ee); }

components.name: Floating Action Button
components.description: 52px Verde Mata circle, always present: an envelope (email) near the top, an up arrow (back to top) past 300px. Over the footer it turns white with a Verde Profundo icon.
components.css: .ds-fab-row { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: center; } .ds-fab-dark { padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--color-green-deep, #0b6630), var(--color-green-night, #0a4d27)); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-fab { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-fab:hover { background: var(--color-green-deep, #0b6630); transform: scale(1.08); } .ds-fab:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-green-dark, #0e7a3a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-fab--on-dark { background: #fff; color: var(--color-green-deep, #0b6630); } .ds-fab--on-dark:hover { background: var(--color-green-light, #e8f5ee); } .ds-fab--on-dark:focus-visible { outline-color: #fff; }

components.css: .ds-photo-ground { padding: 1.5rem; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.45), rgba(0,0,0,0.65)); border-radius: 12px; display: inline-block; } .ds-btn-light { padding: 0.75rem 2rem; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-black, #1a1a1a); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); border: none; border-radius: 100px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-light:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-btn-light:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.css: .ds-foot { padding: 24px; max-width: 360px; background: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--color-green-deep, #0b6630), var(--color-green-night, #0a4d27)); color: #fff; border-radius: 12px; font-family: var(--font-family, Nunito, sans-serif); } .ds-foot-heading { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-foot-group { display: flex; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-foot-group:focus-within { border-color: #fff; } .ds-foot-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 16px; border: none; outline: none; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-foot-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); } .ds-foot-btn { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 24px; border: none; background: #fff; color: var(--color-green-deep, #0b6630); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-foot-btn:hover { background: var(--color-green-light, #e8f5ee); } .ds-foot-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-green-deep, #0b6630); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-foot-chip { margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; background: var(--color-green-night, #0a4d27); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-foot-chip--error { border: 1px solid #fff; }

narrative.overview:
This is a scout's field notebook made digital: a working tool first, decorated second. Every surface assumes it may be read on a phone, outdoors, mid-activity — the cancioneiro sung around a fire, the programa checked on a trail. The system is warm and welcoming to the families evaluating the agrupamento, fresh and optimistic like the movement itself, and trustworthy enough to carry the CNE name. Practicality always wins: clarity of type, generous touch targets, and instant feedback outrank any flourish.

The palette is CNE identity worn honestly — Verde Escutista does the wayfinding, Amarelo Flor-de-Lis provides the rare spark, and everything else is quiet paper-and-ink neutrals. Nunito, rounded and friendly at every weight, keeps the voice approachable without losing officialdom. Depth is ambient and restrained: surfaces sit nearly flat at rest and lift only in response to the user.
keyCharacteristics: Tool-first pragmatism: content and controls stay legible in the field, on small screens, in sunlight.
One green voice: Verde Escutista is identity, wayfinding, and action — used with intent, never as wallpaper.
Friendly and tactile: pill buttons, soft radii, instant press feedback (`scale(0.97)` on `:active`).
Ambient depth: 1px hairline borders at rest; shadows appear on hover, overlays, and floating chrome.
Motion is compositor-friendly, brief (150–300ms), and fully disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

rules.name: The One Yellow Rule
rules.body: Amarelo Flor-de-Lis appears at most once per viewport, on dark ground or as a filled shape. Its rarity is what makes it ceremonial; yellow text on white is banned outright. In the hero it is the carousel progress pill. The footer carries no yellow at all: its headings, focus ring and status icons are white on the green, and the Subscrever action is white with Verde Profundo text.

rules.name: The Small Green Rule
rules.body: Brand green is for size, Verde Mata is for reading. If green text is under 24px (18.66px bold), or white text sits on a green fill, it is Verde Mata or deeper. The one exception is the wordmark.

rules.name: The Verde Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Green means "this is ours" or "this responds". Headings, actions, and active states — never large decorative fills or full-bleed green sections.

rules.name: The Tighter-As-It-Grows Rule
rules.body: Large text gets negative tracking and tight leading (h1–h3: 1.25 / −0.01em; display: 1.05 / −0.02em). Positive letter-spacing is reserved for small uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Ambient Response Rule
rules.body: Shadows are earned by state, not worn at rest. If an element isn't floating, hovered, or modal, a 1px border is its only edge.

dos: **Do** use the tokens in `src/styles/variables.css` for every color, spacing, font size, radius, and shadow — no hardcoded values.
**Do** use `--transition-interactive` for all hover/press/focus states — it transitions only compositor/paint-safe properties.
**Do** give every pressable element instant press feedback (`scale(0.97)` on `:active`); links styled as buttons need it added explicitly.

**Do** verify every surface at 1024px, 768px, and 600px, and give every control a 44px touch target in a `@media (pointer: coarse)` block (`min-height: 44px`, or an invisible `::after` inset when the visual is small by design); chords over lyrics are the one 24px exception.
**Do** respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (motion collapses to ~0ms globally), `prefers-reduced-transparency`, and `prefers-contrast: more` (header falls back to solid white).
**Do** guard hover-dependent interactions with `@media (hover: none)` / `isTouchDevice()` — hover+click on one element causes double-tap bugs on mobile.
donts: **Don't** use `transition: all` — ever. It animates layout properties and causes jank.
**Don't** set Amarelo Flor-de-Lis text on white backgrounds; the contrast fails. Yellow lives on dark photography, deep greens, or as filled shapes carrying dark text.
**Don't** put small text in Verde Escutista or white text on a Verde Escutista fill (3.83:1). Use Verde Mata (The Small Green Rule).
**Don't** use Cinza Suave (#a3a3a3) or lighter for text; it is 2.5:1.
**Don't** nest `backdrop-filter` materials (the mobile nav panel is solid white on purpose).
**Don't** animate layout properties (width, height, top, margin); move things with `transform` and fade with `opacity`.
**Don't** introduce a second font family or positive letter-spacing on large text.
**Don't** add resting shadows to in-flow content; elevation is a response, not a costume (The Ambient Response Rule).
